title: John Lear admits he made up Dulce firefight story

tellings.quote: Leer said, "Oh yeah, I made that up." He actually said this,

plain: John Lear, a pilot who spread the story of a gun battle between American forces and alien beings in an underground base beneath Archuleta Mesa near Dulce, New Mexico, later said of that story, "Oh yeah, I made that up." The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels that Lear really said this, in the early 1990s, in the course of a story about Paul Bennewitz, an Albuquerque businessman who came to believe in the Dulce base; if true, one of the best known tales of the era began as an invention.
